preconditions.expression: n == len(s) and isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 and isinstance(s, str) and s.islower() and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input consists of an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000) followed by a lowercase Latin alphabet string s of length n.

postconditions.description: Output string t has the same length as input string s and contains exactly the same multiset of characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: Output string t consists only of lowercase Latin alphabet characters.

Output string t has the maximum possible palindromic count among all strings with the same multiset of characters as s. Here, palindromic_count(t) is the number of palindromic substrings in t, and max_palindromic_count(s) is the maximum such count achievable by any permutation of s.
